headline: Anthropic reports layered defenses cut observed reasoning extraction by 10–100×
summary: In an Oct. 12, 2026 research post, Anthropic describes layered defenses against attempts to extract Claude reasoning for unauthorized model distillation. The company reports that, after full deployment, reasoning tokens it identified as extracted by distillers on its own platform were consistently 10 to 100 times lower than before; it also says its two-stage classifier caught the extraction techniques described in its September report. This is a provider-reported operational measure, not an independent efficacy evaluation. Anthropic says it has not yet seen a highly sophisticated persistent attempt against the defenses, expects attackers to adapt, and reports integration changes, a benign-request false-positive rate below 0.1%, and charging for some blocked requests.
